RT by @no_itsmyturn: Saudi Arabia announced the establishment of the Multinational Maritime Defense Alliance, to protect freedom of navigation and secure global energy supply routes in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the Red Sea, and the Gulf of Aden. In a joint statement signed by 14 of the participating countries in the alliance’s founding meeting, the countries committed to strengthen cooperation in the areas of maritime security, information and intelligence sharing, operational planning, joint exercises, and the execution of joint maritime operations aimed at enhancing maritime security. Saudi Arabia will be considered the leading state of the Coalition and its permanent headquarters. “The founding states affirm that the establishment of this multinational maritime defense coalition represents a strategic step towards enhancing maritime security in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the Red Sea, and the Gulf of Aden, consolidating defense cooperation among member states, and supporting stability and prosperity,” the statement said.
